clue.text: A very quiet old location for fitting

parts.note: PP, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
a site is a location

explanation.surface: Someone describes a silent, long-established spot as just right for a fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Apposite remarks are apt or suitable to the occasion, so the word is a synonym for fitting.

clue.text: Take away a book on French aristocrat over time

parts.note: duc is French for duke

explanation.surface: Someone takes a book about a French nobleman over a period of time.
explanation.definitionFit: To abduct is to carry someone off by force, a synonym for take away.

clue.text: Layabout turned up in spot at opera

indicators.note: turned up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An idler spotted at the opera house.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'turned up' means read from bottom to top. 'in' signals the hidden run inside 'spot at opera'.
explanation.definitionFit: A couch potato is an idle person, so potato alone is used for a layabout.

clue.text: Toss medical support

definitions.meaning: a cloth band that holds an injured arm

explanation.surface: A patient throws aside a medical brace.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: to hurl, and a bandage loop cradling an injured arm.

clue.text: Sympathetic expression by Mike about round proposition

indicators.note: about means going round, so the comforting word surrounds the round letter

parts.note: 'there, there' is said to comfort someone
O is round in shape
Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A sympathetic remark from someone called Mike about a round proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a proposition to be proved is a theorem.

clue.text: End part of a sentence

definitions.meaning: an end is an aim or purpose, as in 'the end justifies the means'
in grammar, the noun phrase that receives the verb's action

explanation.surface: A grammar lesson about the final piece of a sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a goal or purpose, and the grammatical component acted on by the verb.

clue.text: Something cheeky with drink in a toast

parts.note: the bottom is made of cheeks, a playful pun
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: Someone with a cheeky manner raises a drink in a toast.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottoms up is a cheery phrase said when raising glasses, urging all to drink.

clue.text: Type in outskirts of Giza possibly?

definitions.text: Type in outskirts of Giza possibly?

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters could be arranged another way
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters, here of Giza

explanation.surface: A person you might meet on the edges of Giza.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' shuffles TYPEIN with GA, the outer letters of Giza. Read whole, the clue describes the answer, since Giza is in Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone living around Giza, the city of the pyramids, would be a native of Egypt.

clue.text: Excessive line restrained by trio almost in silence

indicators.note: restrained by means held inside, so the trimmed trio word encloses the other pieces
almost means one letter short, so the trio number loses a letter

parts.note: a trio is three
OTT, over the top, means excessive

explanation.surface: An over-the-top line is held back by three people, almost in silence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims THREE to THRE, and 'restrained by' places OTTL inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To throttle is to choke, and figuratively to suppress or silence.

clue.text: Exhaustive conclusion in legal document

indicators.note: in places the word for conclusion inside the word for the legal document

parts.note: a deed is a signed legal document, such as one transferring property
the tail is the end or conclusion of something

explanation.surface: A lawyer drafts an exhaustive closing clause for a contract.
explanation.definitionFit: A detailed account is thorough and covers every point, so it is exhaustive.

clue.text: Celebrity hoarding a lot of currency is durable figure

indicators.note: hoarding means the celebrity word holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: a star is a celebrity

indicators.note: a lot of, but not all, means the last letter is dropped from the currency

parts.note: the yen is the Japanese currency

explanation.surface: A famous person stockpiles cash and ends up a lasting figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot of' means most but not all of the currency word; 'hoarding' makes the celebrity hold it. A stayer in racing is a horse that lasts the distance.
explanation.definitionFit: A stayer is a horse or person with stamina who keeps going over a long distance, hence a durable figure.

clue.text: Bosun's heart is with lower flat- bottomed boat

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its middle letter, here from the sailor's title

parts.note: a cow is something that lows, i.e. moos

explanation.surface: A boatswain's heart is set on a flat-bottomed vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lower' is not 'more low' but 'one that lows': a cow.
explanation.definitionFit: A scow is a wide, flat-bottomed barge for carrying cargo.

clue.text: Pet, say, on lead for exercise excited corgi? That's positive

parts.note: a cat is an example of a pet, as 'say' signals

indicators.note: the lead for a word is its first letter, taken here from exercise
excited suggests the letters of corgi are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A pet on a lead heading out for a walk meets a worked-up corgi: no doubt about it.
explanation.definitionFit: Categoric statements are absolute and unqualified, so the word means positive or definite.

clue.text: Note in autumn period musical group

indicators.note: in puts the note inside the abbreviation for the autumn month

parts.note: Oct is short for October, an autumn month
te is the seventh note of the tonic sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A musical group plays a note during its autumn season.
explanation.definitionFit: An octet is an ensemble of eight musicians, a kind of musical group.

clue.text: Thin layer in art form

definitions.meaning: a fine coating, such as oil on water
cinema, the art of moving pictures

explanation.surface: A thin layer of paint as part of an artwork.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a thin coating, and the medium of motion pictures.

clue.text: Direct broadcasting etc in turbulent time

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step
turbulent suggests the letters of time are churned up

parts.note: the media covers broadcasting, the press and so on

explanation.surface: Live broadcasting during a stormy period of history.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turbulent' gives IMTE here, an order chosen so that 'in' can place the media inside it after the M.
explanation.definitionFit: Immediate means with nothing in between, as in direct contact or one's immediate superior.

clue.text: On reflection, noticed son facing trouble in drinking bout

indicators.note: on reflection, as in a mirror, means the word for noticed is read backwards

parts.note: to have noticed something is to have seen or saw it
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: Thinking back, someone saw their son in difficulties during a boozy session.
explanation.definitionFit: Wassail is old festive revelry with plenty of spiced ale, so a drinking bout.

clue.text: Excellent feature of tennis?

definitions.meaning: British slang for superb or great
hitting the ball downward hard, a stroke in tennis

explanation.surface: A tennis fan praises the game's best moves.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a British slang word for terrific, and the act of hitting overhead smashes in tennis.

clue.text: Sample after records ornamental textile

indicators.note: after puts the sample word following the word for records

parts.note: tapes are recordings
to try something is to sample it

explanation.surface: A museum sample of decorative cloth is studied after reading records.
explanation.definitionFit: A tapestry is a woven fabric with pictorial designs, hung for decoration.

clue.text: Chap touring yard with damage in Asian country

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the word for chap surrounds the abbreviation for yard

parts.note: a chap is a man
to mar is to damage or spoil

explanation.surface: A man travels around a yard that has been damaged, somewhere in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Myanmar, formerly Burma, is a country in South-East Asia.

clue.text: Stagger very loyal person

explanation.surface: A devoted friend who totters.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to sway, and a steadfast person who can be relied on.

clue.text: Manage croupier on a regular basis

indicators.note: on a regular basis means taking every other letter of croupier, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A casino croupier who copes with the job day after day.
explanation.definitionFit: To cope is to manage or get by under difficulty.

clue.text: American sailor in Washington held up accompaniment for dessert

indicators.note: in places the American sailor pieces inside the capital's abbreviation
held up in a down clue means the capital's abbreviation is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: DC, District of Columbia, is Washington
a tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: A US sailor in the capital is delayed, then comes the pudding course.
explanation.definitionFit: Custard is a sweet sauce poured over puddings, a classic British accompaniment to dessert.

clue.text: Suspect aims about working method in plant

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shuffled letters go round the method abbreviation
suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters of aims are not to be trusted in order

parts.note: MO, modus operandi, is a working method

explanation.surface: Dubious aims behind a gardener's method.
explanation.definitionFit: Mimosa is a flowering shrub or tree, such as the sensitive plant or yellow-blossomed acacia.

clue.text: Attitude adopted among finest ancestors

indicators.note: among means the letters sit within the run of finest ancestors

explanation.surface: A point of view taken up from the best of one's forebears.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is a position or standpoint someone takes up, the attitude they adopt.

clue.text: Heartfelt source of sorrow recalled in dispatch

indicators.note: recalled means called back, so the combined letters are read backwards

parts.note: deep feelings are heartfelt ones

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter, here from sorrow

explanation.surface: Deep grief remembered in a hasty message.
explanation.definitionFit: Dispatch as a noun means promptness or haste, which is speed.

clue.text: Charlie remains with purpose as source of money

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
ash is what remains after burning
the point of something is its purpose

explanation.surface: Someone named Charlie treats leftovers as a deliberate way of making money.
explanation.definitionFit: A cash machine in a wall dispenses banknotes, so it is a place to get money; the British name for an ATM.

clue.text: Greek character with a number quietly in bars

parts.note: pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A Greek man and a number of others drink quietly in pubs.
explanation.definitionFit: In musical notation, the marking for playing softly appears over the bars of a score.

clue.text: Shade without initial evidence of sun — a feature of office life?

indicators.note: without initial means the first letter of the word for shade is dropped

parts.note: a tint is a shade of colour
a ray of light is evidence of sunshine

explanation.surface: An office worker notes shade versus sunshine through the window.
explanation.definitionFit: The tray on a desk where incoming paperwork waits is a fixture of working at an office.

clue.text: Marks a tin containing a limited space for biscuit

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for marks, the old German currency

indicators.note: containing means the word for tin holds the trimmed space word inside it

parts.note: a can is a tin

indicators.note: limited means cut short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: room is space

explanation.surface: Instructions on a biscuit tin with a little space marked out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'limited' drops the last letter of the space word, and 'containing' puts what is left inside the tin word; Marks is the old German currency.
explanation.definitionFit: A macaroon is a sweet almond or coconut biscuit.

clue.text: Old bloke, it's said, one that lets off steam

indicators.note: it's said means the word for an old bloke is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: geezer is British slang for a man, often an older one

explanation.surface: An old man who rants: someone who lets off steam.
explanation.definitionFit: A geothermal spring that periodically spouts hot water and vapour; in Britain also a gas water heater.

clue.text: Support about to be found in commercial poll

parts.note: an ad is a commercial

indicators.note: to be found in means the word for about sits inside the other pieces

parts.note: a poll is a vote
ca, circa, means about

explanation.surface: Backing for a cause turns up in an advertising survey.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a policy is to recommend or champion it, a verb synonym for support.
